name: 4 · Inbox triage: job applications → CV checklist

parameters.content:
## 4 · Inbox triage: job applications → CV checklist
Page: **http://localhost:5678/webhook/applications**. The inbox is read-only: nothing is marked read, moved or sent.
AI runs only when someone clicks "Summarise" on the page, a batch at a time, and never scores or ranks candidates. Roles and settings live in the "Triage roles" and "Triage settings" tables.

### New email in the inbox (read-only) → find applications → read CVs
Keyword rules pick out applications (no AI). CV text is read locally from PDF or Word and stored with the CV file under files/applications.

### Read PDF CVs (after each inbox batch, or on request)
Reads the text of stored PDF CVs with n8n's "Extract from File" node, 100 per run, and queues them for the AI summary.

### Show the applications page
http://localhost:5678/webhook/applications (add ?demo=1 to hide names for recordings).

### "Summarise" button → OpenAI, one batch
Only when AI is switched on. Sends the role checklist and the CV text (cut to max_cv_chars) for each waiting CV, then records the checklist. Failed ones are retried on the next click.

### Shortlist / Not now buttons
A person records the decision; the AI never does.

### Turn AI on / off
Writes ai_enabled in the Triage settings table.

### View a stored CV
Only CV files recorded for an application can be opened.

### Set up tables (first run)
Creates the tables and adds the starting roles and settings where missing. Safe to run again.

meta.description: Reads the inbox read-only, picks out job applications, reads CVs locally and, on request, summarises each CV against the role checklist. People make every decision.
